German wording: Pfizer/phqscreeners.com PHQ-9 German for Germany, https://www.phqscreeners.com/images/sites/g/files/g10060481/f/201412/PHQ9_German%20for%20Germany.pdf (sha256 55602781b1575683a82d50ac6484868b7b176abaf5ee19fca71e018fa1ed8840, fetched 2026-09-25); cross-checked against the KBV copy of the Loewe (c) UKE PHQ-9, https://update.kbv.de/ita-update/Medizinische-Dokumentationen/Depression/KBV_ITA_VHEX_PHQ-9-Fragebogen.pdf (sha256 f85b844f77783931202833fbd214416becc2ed75c4e9ed43dc974becdf8bfbd0). note: Code derivation: data/kohlmann_2016_phq9.py melts the S1 Data columns phq9_1..phq9_9 unchanged, so item IS the source column name; the column names carry position only, no wording at any level (no labels in the CSV). The paper names the nine symptoms only as short tags ('loss of interest, feeling down, sleeping problems, loss of energy, appetite change, feelings of failure, trouble concentrating, psychomotor change, suicidal ideations'), in PHQ-9 order, and cites Kroenke et al. 2001 (ref 23); code -> wording therefore rests on standard PHQ-9 numbering (mapping_basis=paper_order in the instrument-order sense; heekerens2025_phq/batch_431 precedent), and is then VERIFIED against the paper's per-symptom rates (verification_kohlmann_2016_phq9.csv): all nine live %resp>=1 values reproduce the Results' named-symptom rates, each matching exactly one symptom. Step 3b: 9 live items, resp 0-3, PHQ-9 total M 5.51 SD 4.63 (complete cases n=1239) vs Table 1 'Depression, mean (SD) 5.5 (4.6)' -- matches the PHQ-9. Administered language German (three Hamburg cardiology sites; senior author Loewe produced the German PHQ-D). Neither the paper nor the S1 Data carries any German item wording (the paper is English and gives only the English symptom tags; the CSV has no labels), so item_text/instructions/option_text are the standard German PHQ-D wording (Pfizer German-for-Germany form), and that the study used it is an inference -> text_source=canonical_instrument. The KBV/UKE copy agrees word-for-word on items 1-9 except trivial punctuation (checked here: KBV item 2 ends with '.', item 3 has no comma after 'Schwierigkeiten' or before 'oder vermehrter', item 7 reads 'z.B. beim Zeitunglesen'). Deviations from the Pfizer PDF: item 3's 'durchzuschlafen,oder' (missing space) corrected to 'durchzuschlafen, oder'; instructions omit the form's marking line '(Bitte markieren Sie die zutreffende Antwort mit "check")' and the trailing functional-difficulty question (not in the table); header anchors 'Über-haupt nicht', 'An einzel-nen Tagen', 'Bei-nahe jeden Tag' de-hyphenated from column-header line breaks. _translated = official English PHQ-9 (parallel version, official_instrument_english), instructions without its '(Use check to indicate your answer)' line. Option axis: resp 0-3 as stored (script asserts 0..3; Methods list the four frequency categories in this order); resp>=1 reproducing the paper's 'at least several days' rates confirms 0 = 'Überhaupt nicht / Not at all'. Every item uses all four levels. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv row 'PHQ and GAD screener family' verdict=ship (express grant: 'no permission is required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute them'), applied; the German PDF footer carries the same grant: 'Für die Vervielfältigung, Übersetzung, Darstellung oder Verteilung ist keine Genehmigung erforderlich.'
public_note: The study's German PHQ-9 form was not published, so the item text shown is the standard German PHQ-D wording with the official English PHQ-9 alongside; the item order was checked against the paper's per-symptom frequencies.

note: Code derivation: item IS the source column name (data/stolz_2015_euthanasia.py melts DEATH_ITEMS=c14x1..c14x6 unchanged from the S1 .sav, sha256 d01c5b9795ef62501e7a78ab47a8181e5a2473e741c8200308055cbc78bd229d), so mapping_basis=data_labels and Step 5b is exempt. Words: item_text = the .sav's own VARIABLE labels for c14x1..c14x6, verbatim (6/6; no trailing period in source, none added). option_text = the .sav's own VALUE labels 1-4, identical on all 6 items: 1 'stimme völlig zu', 2 'stimme eher schon zu', 3 'stimme eher nicht zu', 4 'stimme überhaupt nicht zu'; value 5 'weiß nicht, kann ich nicht sagen' is labelled but has zero rows in the .sav and is not in the live resp set, so it is not shipped. Response axis: live item x resp counts reproduce the .sav cell for cell (24/24, e.g. c14x1 445/632/235/258, c14x4 358/291/535/584; live n ids 1958, rows 10249). Direction is consistent with content: c14x4 (ban euthanasia) and c14x6 (law would be abused) correlate +0.60 with each other and -0.29 to -0.54 with c14x3 (self-determination) and c14x5 (would use it myself), which correlate +0.48; this matches 1=agree for both item groups. Language German (Austrian IFES face-to-face CAPI survey 2014). English: the paper, S1 Table (.s002) and S2 Table (.s003, sha256 54732918a45dd1f4142156ea0b158735df8b79f824d1a027919f02aca361eb5c) carry NO English for the c14 battery. The paper never uses or mentions these six items, and neither article table image (t001 sample characteristics, t002 regressions) contains them. So item_text_translated is this project's own machine translation of the German labels. option_text_translated reuses the study's own English for the identical anchor strings, from S2 Table's header ('agree completely | rather agree | rather disagree | disagree completely', line breaks joined), which renders the same four value labels used on the c15 battery. Hence translation_source=mixed: items machine_translation, options study_supplied. A line on the public issues page is owed when this goes live. instructions blank: no question stem or intro text in the .sav (no file label, no notes), the paper or S1/S2. Rights: the items are not a published instrument. They are the study's own survey questions (Med Uni Graz / IFES 'Studie zum Thema Lebensende', 2014, ref 39 of the paper), published by the authors in a CC BY 4.0 PLOS ONE deposit. An exact-phrase web search for the c14x6 wording and a combined search for c14x1/c14x2 found no external originating instrument. With no third-party originator, no restriction exists to quote. Shipped on that basis; no register row written (a round may not write ship rows).
